literal: For nobility of character, the touchstone what if you ask, defeat even from those who are not equals accepting.
translation: If you ask what is the touchstone of perfect character, it is accepting defeat even from those who are not one's equals.
modern: சான்றாண்மைக்கு உரைகல் எதுவென்றால், தமக்குச் சமமில்லாத தாழ்ந்தவர்களிடமிருந்தும் தோல்வியை ஒப்புக்கொள்வதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate test of a person's noble character. The word 'கட்டளை' refers to a touchstone, which is used to test the purity of gold. The author states that the true test of nobility ('சால்பு') is one's willingness to accept defeat ('தோல்வி கொளல்') even when dealing with those who are not their equals ('துலையல்லார்'). Instead of using power, status, or intellect to crush an inferior opponent, a truly noble person shows greatness by yielding with grace and humility.
